definitions.explanation: Attaches to a number to create an ordinal: first, second, third, etc. Used with both Sino-Japanese and native numbers.

examples.english: I arrived first (was the first to come).

examples.japanese: ⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧{番目|ばんめ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please look at the third shelf from the top.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧{番目|ばんめ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}{大国|たいこく}→経済大国：27186_keizaitaikoku⟧だ。
examples.english: Japan is the third-largest economy in the world.
examples.notes: 〜{番目|ばんめ}に + adjective means 'the ~th most [adjective].'

notes:
{番目|ばんめ} turns a cardinal number into an ordinal number.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{数字|すうじ}→数字：03361_suuji⟧ + {番目|ばんめ}: the ~th one
- ⟦{数字|すうじ}→数字：03361_suuji⟧ + {番目|ばんめ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + adjective: the ~th most [adjective]

EXAMPLES:
- ⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧{番目|ばんめ}: first
- ⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧{番目|ばんめ}: second
- ⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧{番目|ばんめ}: third
- ⟦{十|じゅう}→十：00708_juu⟧{番目|ばんめ}: tenth

CONTRAST WITH {目|め}:
- {番目|ばんめ} is used after a number to indicate rank or order in a sequence
- 〜⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ attaches directly to counters: {三人目|さんにんめ} (third person), {二回目|にかいめ} (second time)
